edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against _operator inside the onlyOperator modifier.
msg.sender is compared against _owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
isOperator derives its result from _msgSender().
transferOperator forwards execution to the internal _transferOperator.
newOperator_ flows into the operator assignment performed by _transferOperator.
_transferOperator writes the _operator state variable.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed by the checkEpoch modifier condition.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed by the checkStartTime modifier condition.
checkEpoch implements the timestamp gating unsafe operation.
checkStartTime implements the start-time gating unsafe operation.
After the timestamp gate passes the epoch counter arithmetic update is executed.
The epoch state variable influences the checkEpoch gating condition via nextEpochPoint.
epoch = epoch.add(1) mutates the epoch state variable.
checkEpoch gates the external update() function.
nextEpochPoint reads startTime to compute the next epoch timestamp.
nextEpochPoint multiplies epoch by the period state variable.
nextEpochPoint uses the epoch counter as multiplier.
The value of nextEpochPoint is compared against now inside the timestamp gate.
setPeriod is restricted by the onlyOperator modifier.
setPeriod writes the period state variable.
_period argument is assigned to the period state variable.
timeElapsed is computed from the returned blockTimestamp local.
blockTimestampLast is subtracted from blockTimestamp to form timeElapsed.
timeElapsed is the divisor of the cumulative price delta division.
price0Cumulative local is the numerator base of the division.
price0CumulativeLast is subtracted from the current cumulative value before division.
The division result is cast to uint224 and stored into price0Average.
update writes the new blockTimestamp into blockTimestampLast.
update stores the fresh cumulative value into price0CumulativeLast.
update() invokes the unsafe division operation body.
token parameter selects which average price feeds the multiplication.
amountIn parameter is the multiplicand scaled by the price average.
price0Average is multiplied by amountIn inside consult.
consult() executes the price multiplication and decode operation.
The decoded multiplication result is returned as amountOut.
Constructor stores the resolved IUniswapV2Pair into pair.
Constructor reads and caches pair.token0() into token0.
Constructor reads and caches pair.token1() into token1.
Constructor initializes blockTimestampLast from pair reserves.
Constructor initializes price0CumulativeLast from the pair.
Constructor initializes price1CumulativeLast from the pair.
Constructor calls pairFor to derive the pair address.
factory parameter is passed into UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
tokenA parameter is passed into UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
tokenB parameter is passed into UniswapV2Library.pairFor.
pairFor returns the computed deterministic pair address as lpt.
transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to address(0).
renounceOwnership is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter is validated and assigned to _owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only used as a selector inside consult(), so it is subsumed by the consult core function.
amountIn is the multiplicand of the price scaling operation and carries no independent identity.
amountOut is the return value produced by consult() and does not need a separate graph node.
factory argument is consumed only by pairFor() to build the CREATE2 pair address.
tokenA argument is consumed only by pairFor() for token sorting and hashing.
tokenB argument is consumed only by pairFor() for token sorting and hashing.
lpt is the direct return value of pairFor() and is merged into that core function.
price0Cumulative feeds the numerator of the update division operation.
price1Cumulative feeds the second division in update() and merges into the same operation node.
blockTimestamp only serves to derive timeElapsed used by the division operation.
timeElapsed is the divisor of the unsafe division and is fully represented there.
newOperator_ is validated and written to _operator only inside _transferOperator.
newOwner is used solely for the zero-address check and ownership assignment in transferOwnership.
_period is the governance input assigned to the period state variable by setPeriod.
_startTime is epoch configuration input related to the same period/epoch governance surface as setPeriod.
